faq.question: Do you only work on new construction, or also existing properties?
faq.answer: Both. We help clients buy and sell existing residential and commercial properties, and we design and build new construction from the ground up.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take from consultation to handover?
faq.answer: It depends on scope — a property purchase can close in a few weeks, while custom construction projects typically run 4-12 months. We give you a clear timeline during the planning stage.

faq.question: Do you provide financing or valuation support?
faq.answer: We don't originate loans directly, but our consulting team provides property valuation and can connect you with trusted financing partners.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We currently operate across major metro areas including San Francisco, Austin, Denver, and Phoenix, with projects expanding regionally.
